title: INL Lab Website Launched
content:
We are excited to announce the launch of the Intelligent Networks Lab (INL) website! This platform will serve as a hub for our research, publications, and updates. We invite you to explore our work in intelligent wireless networks, programmable data planes, and quantum communication.
Stay tuned for upcoming research projects, publications, and news related to our lab's activities.
Visit our website at [https://intelligent-networks-lab.org](https://intelligent-networks-lab.org) to learn more about our team and research focus.
